{{Short description|Russian topologist}}
'''Iulia Antonivna Rozhanska''' ({{langx|uk|Юлія Антонівна Рожанська}}; {{langx|ru|Юлия Антоновна Рожанская}}; 1901 – 23 April 1967), also [[Polonisation|spelt]] '''Julia Różańska''', was a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] [[topologist]]. After studying under [[Pavel Aleksandrov]], she was an associate professor at [[Moscow State University]]. She was a member of the [[Moscow Mathematical Society]].<ref name="ANS">{{cite journal |last1=Apushkinskaya |first1=Darya E. |last2=Nazarov |first2=Alexander I. |last3=Sinkevich |first3=Galina I. |title=In Search of Shadows: The First Topological Conference, Moscow 1935 |journal=The Mathematical Intelligencer |date=December 2019 |volume=41 |issue=4 |pages=37–42 |doi=10.1007/s00283-019-09907-6 | issn=0343-6993 |arxiv=1903.02065 |s2cid=119170777 }}</ref> She attended the [[First International Topological Conference]], Moscow, 1935.<ref name="ANS"/><ref>{{cite journal |title=Deaths |journal=Успехи математических наук |date=1968 |volume=23 |page=211 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=KttPAAAAYAAJ&q=%D0%AE%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%8F+%D0%90%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BD%D0%B0+%D0%A0%D0%BE%D0%B6%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F+(1901%E2%80%931967) |access-date=1 May 2024 |publisher=Объединенное науч.-техн. изд-во НКТП СССР, Глав. ред. общетехнической лит-ры и номографии |language=ru}}</ref>
